subject: Error: Labels can only be specified in conjunction with breaks

messages.author: 88ada8d8fec8b6be
messages.subject: Error: Labels can only be specified in conjunction with breaks
parts:
Hello,

I was running the following command:

qplot(factor(Date),value,data=ordersByMonth,geom="bar",stat="identity",xlab="Months",ylab="Number
of Orders",main="Orders by Month") +geom_bar(fill="skyblue")
+ scale_fill_discrete(guide="none")
+ scale_x_discrete(labels=unique(format.Date(ordersByMonth
$Date,format="%b-'%y")))
+ coord_flip();

on a linux machine with R-2.14-2 and didn't have any issues. When I
run this on R (R-2.14-0) on a Macbook, I get an error as follows:

Error: Labels can only be specified in conjunction with breaks

Any idea why this is so? I tried to use
breaks=levels(unique(ordersByMonth$Date) in scale_x_discrete but that
doesn't seem to solve it.

Any help would be much appreciated.

Regards,

Arun

I imagine your 2.14.0 installation has ggplot2 0.8.9, while the 2.14.2
installation has ggplot2 0.9.0. The way in which labels were specified
changed between those two. You could update ggplot on the 2.14.0
machine, but this is complicated by the fact that you need 2.14.1 for
version 0.9.0.
